evidence.title: Z Squared agrees to acquire full ownership of Paradox Data

summary: Z Squared announced an agreement to purchase the remaining shares of Paradox Data, taking full control of the AI-powered data analytics company. The acquisition aims to integrate Paradox's machine‑learning tools into Z Squared's suite, strengthening its position in the enterprise AI market.
title: Z Squared to Acquire Paradox Data, Gaining Full Ownership of AI-driven Data Platform
